description: This file defines an internal struct 'CoarseStopwatch' used for timing durations with decently coarse accuracy within the Orleans project. It provides methods for starting, stopping, resetting, and measuring elapsed time using the system's environment tick count.

classes.name: CoarseStopwatch
classes.description: A lightweight, non-allocating stopwatch implementation for timing durations approximately within tens of milliseconds.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new stopwatch, optionally with a specified elapsed time.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a stopwatch instance from a given timestamp.

methods.name: FromTimestamp (long, long)
methods.description: Creates a stopped stopwatch with specified start and end timestamps.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the stopwatch if it is not already running.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to a stopped state with zero elapsed time.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch, calculating the elapsed time.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current environment tick count for timing.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the internal raw timestamp value.
